ios.desc:
Simon is the ultimate real-world photo challenge game where creativity meets competition! Every day, get a unique scavenger hunt-style challenge that pushes your imagination. Can you snap the perfect photo and keep your streak alive?

* Why You'll Love Simon:
- Daily Photo Challenges – Fun, unpredictable prompts that test your creativity.
- AI Photo Validation – Submit your photo & get instant feedback.
- Compete with Friends – Climb the leaderboard and build epic streaks.
- Scavenger Hunt Mode – Explore the world with real-world picture quests.
- Quick & Easy Fun – Play anywhere—at home, in the city, or with friends!

* How It Works:
1. Get Your Daily Photo Challenge.
2. Snap a Picture That Matches.
3. Submit & Get Instant AI Validation.
4. Earn Points, Build Streaks, & Climb the Leaderboards!

* Who’s This Game For?
- Creative minds who love photography & visual puzzles.
- Scavenger hunt fans who enjoy real-world quests.
- Competitive players who want to top the photo challenge leaderboard.

Ready to prove your skills? Download Simon now and take on today’s photo challenge!
